item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00459","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C05","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 is a clear and close drafting precursor. It invokes the same February 12 economic statement, presents substantially the same sequence of economic measures—home building, highway expenditures, urban renewal, defense procurement, easier credit, and Post Office modernization—and repeats the commitment to take executive action or propose measures to Congress. The child expands this compact account into a detailed policy letter while retaining its language, logic, and ordering. C05 also supplies material administrative background for accelerating planned public works during an economic downturn, while C03 parallels several small-business policies, but neither matches the child's overall drafting as closely as C12.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In that statement I cited a number of governmental activities currently aiding the economy. These include measures by the federal Reserve authorities to ease credit, various steps to stimulate home-building, a $600 million increase in federal aid highway expenditures next fiscal year, sharply increased activity under the urban renewal program, and a more than $5 billion increase in defense procurement and construction","parent_excerpt":"many steps have already been taken by the federal government that bear on the situation, such as measures to stimulate home building, to provide greatly increased expenditures under the national highway building program, to provide an increase in activity under the urban renewal program, as well as a sharp rise in the first half of this year in the letting of defense procurement contracts. Added to this list ... [is] the action of the federal Reserve authorities ... to increase the availability of credit","explanation":"C12 contains nearly the same distinctive list of economic measures in substantially the same sequence; the child adds figures and operational detail."},{"child_excerpt":"Fourth, that should additional governmental measures be needed, they will be taken by the Executive Branch or proposed to the Congress.","parent_excerpt":"I shall continue to take, or propose to the Congress, such steps as can contribute effectively to the health of the economy and the welfare of our people.","explanation":"The child closely reuses C12's executive-action-or-congressional-proposal formulation."},{"child_excerpt":"the acceleration of planned and needed public improvements, can be helpful in promoting increased growth of the economy","parent_excerpt":"The possibilities for the acceleration of public works construction in the event that economic conditions make such acceleration desirable.","explanation":"C05 provides distinctive administrative machinery and phrasing connecting planned public works acceleration to economic conditions, which the child describes as having been put into operation."},{"child_excerpt":"tax relief for small business; ... removal of the statutory limit on the life of the Small Business Administration and provision of new authority for loans to small business","parent_excerpt":"One of these recommendations is the extension of the term of the Small Business Administration beyond the date of its present statutory expiration. Others are: (1) Taxes—A one-third reduction in the tax on the first $25,000 of corporation incomes","explanation":"C03 supplies closely corresponding small-business legislative proposals later condensed into the child's pending-measures list."}]}
